title: Emigranten naar Amerika in de 19e eeuw 1980
authors: Swieringa, R.P., Kent State University, Department of History * Kent, USA (primary investigator)
descriptions: Determining demographic, economic and social factors explaining variance in Dutch emigration to the United States in the mid 19th century. Population data of Dutch censuses of 1830, 1849, 1869 and 1878 per community sex, religion, emigration, birth / agricultural report 1875 land type, economical value / mobility and the migration data 1850-1880.
